name: ldd-docs-tools
description: Converts the LDD markdown documents to Word (.docx).

scripts.build: node md-to-html.mjs ../source/LDD-Requirements-Analysis-Report-v1.0.md ./LDD-Requirements-Analysis-Report-v1.0.html && node md-to-html.mjs ../source/LDD-Solution-Design-v1.0.md ./LDD-Solution-Design-v1.0.html && node md-to-html.mjs ../source/LDD-Data-Model-v1.0.md ./LDD-Data-Model-v1.0.html && node html-to-docx.mjs . .. && node add-toc.mjs ..
